title: Final List of Applicants — Advertisement No. 67 (2026) - Lecturer of Computer Science on Fixed Pay
text:
University Recruitment · Registrar Office

Final List of Applicants — Advertisement No. 67 (2026)

Lecturer of Computer Science on Fixed Pay · Search by name, father's name, or challan number below.

With reference to Advertisement No. 67 (2026) and the ETEA written test conducted on August 8, 2026, and email/news
shared on the university webpage dated August 20, 2026 where all candidates who have qualified the test are
requested to submit their online application through the University's job portal, the following applications
have been submitted by the closing date of August 27, 2026:

Sr.No | Applicant Name | Father Name | Challan Number | Amount Paid (Rs.) | Date of Apply

No matching applicant found.

Notes

The list of applicants for various faculty positions has been prepared in order of applications received on the online portal and is published for information of all concerned.

The list does not constitute any shortlisting or merit at this stage.

The eligibility and qualification of applicants shall be determined by the Scrutiny & Qualification Committee in accordance with the prescribed University statutes and regulations.

For further details and updates, please keep visiting the University webpage and the email address provided during the application.

Issued by the
Registrar
